title: Search and ask
description: Search local dictation history, workspace notes and imported connections. Results include up to eight source excerpts.
disclosure: Local search stays on this device. Asking sends your question and up to 20,000 characters of source excerpts to your configured Post Processing provider. Answers include the selected source IDs; inspect the excerpts to check claims.
empty: No matching local sources. Try words used in your notes or dictation.
